Q: Why does modifying a list while iterating over it in Python skip elements? A:

numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]

numbers = [n for n in numbers if n % 2 != 0]

print(numbers) # [1, 3, 5, 7]

Q: How do I solve this error code in relation to this script for unity? A:

You as can see in the List<T> documentation, it resides in System.Collections.Generic namespace.

Therefore you can solve the error by adding:

using System.Collections.Generic;

(this is mentioned by the compiler: "are you missing a using directive ...").

Alternatively (although I wouldn't recommend it here), you can use the fully qualified name whenever you mention a List, e.g.:

public System.Collections.Generic.List<GameObject> propPrefabs;

Q: Can't see pages on page listing after Wordpress update A:

The issue might be the server's memory limit.

QUICK SOLUTION

Add this line to your wp-config.php:

define( 'WP_MAX_MEMORY_LIMIT' , '512M' );

It won't solve the real problem, but it will allow you to keep Wordpress running while you check where the issue comes from.

IMPORTANT:

For anyone reading this answer:

256M is already a lot of memory for rendering a dashboard page. 512M is a huge amount of memory!

The real problem is certainly caused elsewhere by Wordpress configuration or data.

To troubleshoot:

  • First switch to one of the default Wordpress theme and check that the issue isn't caused by your theme.
  • Then try removing plugins.
  • Lastly check the same theme/plugin configuration on a clean database.
